lines.say: All living things are made of cells, and new cells only come from existing cells.
Prokaryotes have no nucleus. Their DNA sits in the nucleoid, with 70 S ribosomes.

draw.alt: Prokaryote with nucleoid beside eukaryote with nucleus

lines.say: Eukaryotes have a nucleus, 80 S ribosomes and membrane-bound organelles.
A secreted protein goes rough E R, then Golgi, then vesicle, then out.
Mitochondria and chloroplasts were once bacteria. They have their own circular DNA.
Condensation joins monomers and releases water. Hydrolysis adds water to break them.
A chain of n monomers has n minus one bonds.
Alpha glucose is for a store. Beta glucose builds cellulose.
Denaturing a protein ruins its shape, but the peptide bonds stay intact.
In DNA, A pairs with T, and G pairs with C.
Enzymes lower activation energy. They don't change delta G.
Km is the half way house: the substrate level at half Vmax.
Compete, Km climbs. Non-compete, the max gets beat.

draw.alt: Competitive inhibitor shifts Km right; non-competitive lowers Vmax

lines.say: ATP hydrolysis releases about 30.5 kilojoules per mole, to drive other reactions.
OIL RIG. Oxidation is loss of electrons, reduction is gain.
Glycolysis, link reaction, citric acid cycle, electron transport chain.

draw.alt: Four stages of respiration in order

lines.say: Altogether that's about 30 to 32 ATP per glucose.
Cyanide stops everything. Oligomycin stops ATP. An uncoupler wastes energy as heat.
Photosynthesis: rubisco fixes C O 2 in the Calvin cycle, in the stroma.
Every body cell has the same genome. Different genes are just switched on.
PMAT. Metaphase lines up in the middle. Anaphase moves away.
Meiosis one separates partners. Meiosis two separates twins.

draw.alt: Homologous pair separates in meiosis I, sister chromatids in meiosis II

lines.say: Count chromosomes by centromeres. DNA content doubles in S phase.
Replication is semi conservative. Polymerase only adds to a three prime end.
The leading strand is continuous. The lagging strand comes in Okazaki fragments.

draw.alt: Leading strand continuous, lagging strand in fragments

lines.say: Lactose lifts the lock. Low glucose lights the lamp.
Silent, missense, nonsense, frameshift. Mildest to usually worst.
Monohybrid cross gives 3 to 1. Dihybrid gives 9 to 3 to 3 to 1.
Small chi square, it fits. Big chi square, it quits.
Recombination frequency can never pass 50 percent.
Apoptosis is a planned demolition. Necrosis is a building collapse.
Telomeres are shoelace tips. Each division wears a little off.
